name: Question 3
problem: During the winter months, the energy consumption of an average household increases by $1\,\text{kWh}$ every week. What differential equation describes the rate of change of energy consumption $E(t)$ (measured in $\text{kWh}$) of an average household during these months? Assume that the time $t$ is measured in weeks.

Question 3
?

During the winter months, the energy consumption of an average household increases by 1kWh every week. What differential equation describes the rate of change of energy consumption E(t) (measured in kWh) of an average household during these months? Assume that the time t is measured in weeks.

a
 dEdt=−1
b
dEdt=1
c
 dEdt=−k,k>0
d
 dEdt=e
e
 dEdt=k,k>0
